title: The role of explainability in creating trustworthy artificial intelligence for health care: a comprehensive survey of the terminology, design choices, and evaluation strategies
reasoning: The paper's central theme is achieving "trustworthy AI," which is framed as an ethical requirement. It explicitly defines trustworthy AI based on conditions that include adhering to "ethical principles and values (ethicality)". The motivation for explainability is consistently linked to ethical considerations and building trust in high-stakes healthcare applications, making ethics a core component of the paper's thesis rather than a peripheral section.
